principle: Let a clear reading hierarchy and one meaningful image lead.
layout: Asymmetric opening, compact index, generous long-form measure.
color: Warm paper and dark ink; one restrained navigation accent.
type: Serif display with utilitarian sans labels.
content: Real titles, dates, excerpts and image captions.
risk: Do not disguise navigation as oversized decorative text.

principle: Make the next action and current state easy to scan.
layout: Stable navigation, aligned records, visible filters and contextual details.
color: Neutral surfaces with distinct status roles.
type: Readable sans, tabular numerals for comparisons.
content: Long names, empty results, errors and realistic record counts.
risk: Avoid spacious marketing cards where users need dense comparison.

principle: Give the object and its useful attributes priority.
layout: Consistent image scale, compareable metadata and clear purchase path.
color: Quiet base that allows materials and product colors to carry expression.
type: Clear product names with subordinate specifications.
content: Actual dimensions, availability, variants and image rights.
risk: Do not trade discoverability for editorial mystery.

principle: Build understanding through specific work and credible process.
layout: Direct proposition, relevant proof, scope and an actionable next step.
color: Brand-led colors with a readable long-form neutral base.
content: Real cases and bounded claims, not fictional endorsements.
risk: Avoid repetitive promotional sections with no new information.

principle: Make identity expressive while dates and attendance stay obvious.
layout: One expressive visual field with a practical event schedule.
color: A deliberate high-contrast pair rather than effects everywhere.
type: Display type for identity; separate functional text hierarchy.
content: Venue, date, access information and real booking destination.
risk: Keep animation and typography from obstructing the schedule.

principle: Help readers find, trust and understand substantial content.
layout: Navigable content outline, calm body measure and contextual examples.
color: Restrained neutral system with semantic callout roles.
type: Durable body text with clear code and annotation styles.
content: Long articles, tables, citations and descriptive link labels.
risk: Do not treat every paragraph as a card or hide important text behind motion.
